title: Geo-fencing and retention lifecycle controls for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments
creator: Sofia Patel
description:
Problem: Customers deploying Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) need strong, auditable controls that guarantee data locality, configurable retention lifecycles, and automated evidence packages for compliance reviews. Current gaps: (1) no first-class geo-locking controls that integrate with runtime failover, (2) retention enforcement is ad-hoc and not surfaced in Console per-customer, (3) evidence generation requires manual log aggregation.

Goal: Deliver a cohesive feature set that lets customers declare allowed regions and failover constraints, define retention lifecycles per dataset/tenant, and produce automated compliance evidence bundles (logs, manifests, policy evaluation traces) on schedule and on-demand. The controls must work in hosted, Dedicated-proxy, and Private (VPC / on-prem) modes.

Scope:
- Admin Console settings: per-organization geo-allowlist, per-route retention windows, and explicit failover partner regions list.
- Runtime enforcement: smart-routing checks at request admit time to prevent disallowed writes/read paths; failover policy evaluator that returns a compliance-safe fallback or rejects.
- Retention enforcement: retention metadata on stored artifacts (KV, cached prefixes, logs) with retention-driver to expire records and generate provenance records.
- Evidence automation: scheduled evidence bundles (signed manifests + tokenized access logs) exported to customer-owned S3 or delivered to an audit UI. Bundles must include model hash, routing decisions, KMS key IDs, and provenance of deleted items.
- On-prem constraints: offline evidence signer mode, local-only KMS integration, and air-gapped bundle export via USB manifest helper.

Non-goals: full legal compliance consulting, implementing tenant-level encrypted backups (separate work).

Risks & trade-offs:
- Additional runtime checks increase tail latency; mitigation: async validation for non-write paths and priority routing for low-latency tiers.
- On-prem heterogeneity: must provide a robust fallback UX if local KMS or export endpoint is misconfigured.

Success metrics:
- Feature adoption: 10 pilot customers configured in Private by end of cycle.
- Evidence generation: automated bundles produced succesfully for 95% of scheduled runs during pilot.
- No regressions in P95 latency >10% for routes with geo-checking enabled (goal).

Links & artifacts:
- Design spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/PRIV-geo-retention-design
- Threat model: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/PRIV-threatmodel-2026
- PoC infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2345
- Console mockups: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcGeoRetentionMockups
- Audit dashboard prototype: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/pmU4k/residency-audit

Implementation notes:
- Implement a compact policy language: allowlist regions + allowed-fallbacks; policy evaluated in router before routing decision.
- Add retention metadata on storage keys and a background retention-driver with a "manifest of deletions" writer for evidence bundles.
- Evidence bundle format: compressed JSON manifest + signed manifest (RS256) + pointer file to related logs. Support S3 push and local export.
- Console: add "Residency & Retention" panel under Organization settings and a per-route toggle for strict enforcement vs soft-warning.

Rollout plan: pilot with 3 on-prem customers (legal teams involved) -> iterate -> opt-in beta for Dedicated -> GA in private-2026.04.
acceptance_criteria: Console: org-level geo-allowlist UI exists and persists to config store
Runtime: routing denies writes to disallowed regions (unit + e2e tests)
Retention: retention-driver expires test keys and writes deletion manifest
Evidence: automated bundles generated on schedule and downloadable; bundle includes routing decisions and KMS IDs
On-prem: bundle export works in air-gapped mode (manual verification)
tasks: Spec: finalize policy grammar and validation rules
Console: build UI and admin guardrails
Runtime: add pre-route residency check and failover evaluator
Storage: attach retention metadata and implement retention-driver
Evidence: implement bundle generator with RS256 signing and S3 export
Tests: unit + integration + e2e + compliance smoke tests
Docs: Confluence how-to and runbook for audits
Pilot: onboard 3 customers and collect feedback
